opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two and three, up to £6,000 per annum research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers with a doctorate who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK; must be resident in the UK and employed by a UK university or hold a UK academic position.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowship to undertake a significant piece of publishable research.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK higher education institutions and UK‑based independent research institutes (trial). Applicants must be employed by the institution.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative original research projects up to five years.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university academic staff (or specialist arts institutions) coordinating a visit of an eminent overseas professor.
opportunities.summary: Invite an overseas senior professor for 3–12 months to enhance skills and knowledge in an under‑represented area.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers (single or collaborative).
opportunities.summary: Large‑scale research centres to achieve step‑change in scholarship.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired senior researchers who have held a UK university post; must reside in the UK and be research active.
opportunities.summary: Support retired researchers to complete a research project.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering fine/performing arts training for school‑age children under 18.
opportunities.summary: Fund arts training for school‑age children (weekends, holidays).

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Undergraduate & Postgraduate

amount.raw: Maximum total award £475,000; bursaries £5,000–£10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or charities offering undergraduate or postgraduate fine/performing arts courses.
opportunities.summary: Provide bursaries to support outstanding undergraduate/postgraduate arts students.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment at lecturer level, ≤2 years post‑PhD experience, and not previously holding a similar prize.
opportunities.summary: Support talented early‑career scholars to build a research team and demonstrate leadership.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary contribution up to £56,000 year one, £28,000 years two/three; research expenses up to £6,000 per annum

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Distinguished researchers in humanities or social sciences employed at a UK university; must not have held a Major Research Fellowship before.
opportunities.summary: Two‑ or three‑year fellowship for established scholars to complete original research.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers (within ten years of PhD) holding a permanent UK university post or long‑term fellowship; nominations made by department head.
opportunities.summary: Award to support outstanding early‑career researchers for any research purpose.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers employed by a UK university with research degree awarding powers; must be resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: 3–24 month fellowship to enable researchers whose teaching/administrative duties have limited research time to complete a project.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships
opportunities.summary: Doctoral scholarships for PhD students to undertake research projects.
